target.label: Outbound to test through
target.none: do not test through a proxy

run.hint: The check sends packets from the router and leaves entries in the core log.

idle.title: No check has run yet
idle.description: Press “Check”: the panel tests traffic interception, DNS and internet access, through the chosen outbound and directly.

reason.model_unavailable: the metabox.dataplane interception settings in UCI could not be read
reason.interception_disabled: interception is off — there is no need for ports and chains
reason.not_listening: nothing is listening on the port. The core may be stopped, or the config may lack a matching inbound
reason.proc_unavailable: could not read the socket list in /proc/net
reason.config_missing: there is no core config on the device
reason.no_dns_inbound: the config has no dns-in on the interception DNS port: dnsmasq sends queries to an empty port
reason.dns_name_unset: no name is set for the DNS probe
reason.no_answer: the DNS probe got no answer
reason.nft_unparsed: the nft output could not be parsed
reason.routing_setup_unavailable: the router could not run the routing check
reason.fwmark_rule_missing: the policy routing rule for marked packets is missing
reason.local_route_missing: the local route is missing. Intercepted traffic may fail to reach the core
reason.dnsmasq_forwarding_missing: dnsmasq is not configured to forward queries to the interception DNS port
reason.proxy_missing: the running core has no such node
reason.not_measured: the core has no latency reading for this node. It was never tested, or the last check failed
reason.unsupported: the check is not supported on this system
